content: With PgBouncer/Supavisor in transaction pooling mode, session-scoped SET commands leak tenant context across requests because the underlying connection is returned to the pool mid-session. Correct pattern: use SET LOCAL (or set_config(..., true)) inside the same transaction as the tenant-scoped queries -- it auto-resets at COMMIT/ROLLBACK and cannot leak. This risk also applies to SQLAlchemy's own connection pool even without pgbouncer, since pooled connections are reused across requests.
